title: Shanghai to continue offering free license plates for EVs in 2026
summary: Shanghai will extend its policy of providing free license plates for electric vehicles (EVs) throughout 2026, renewing a measure originally set to expire at the end of 2025. This policy applies to non-commercial EV purchases and is available to eligible Shanghai residents, companies, and individuals meeting specific social insurance or tax payment criteria. The continuation of this policy underscores Shanghai's commitment to promoting EV adoption, as NEVs already account for over 60% of vehicle registrations in the city, which also hosts major EV players like Tesla and Nio.

title: Michael Burry Is Not Short Tesla Stock — Despite 'Ridiculous' Valuation - Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA)
